cohort: The study included 111 postnatal women aged 18-44 years with a history of two or more miscarriages before 20 weeks of gestation.
finding: Maternal obesity was significantly associated with an increased risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (OR=13.6) and Pregnancy Induced Hypertension (OR=4.2) in women with recurrent miscarriages.
mod_finding: The incidence of LSCS (caesarean section) was higher in overweight and obese mothers, though this finding was not statistically significant.
cross-section timing: Maternal BMI was assessed in the first trimester, and pregnancy outcomes were noted at the time of delivery or immediately postpartum.
